title: Interactive Gradient
description: A glowing ribbon of colour that flows around your cursor like water around a rock.

title: Black Blob Maker
description: Click and hold to grow glossy black blobs that melt into their neighbours.

title: Ocean Landing Page
description: A misty, dark sea in real 3D — click to raise a glowing glass portal out of the water.

title: Text Field Light Reaction
description: A sign-up form whose edges warm into a drifting, eclipse-like glow the faster you type.

title: iPhone Duo Dropdown
description: A Settings dropdown whose menu flips over in 3D like a folding phone, coming into focus through a progressive blur.

title: iPhone Duo Forms
description: A three-step sign-up card that turns like a book page between steps, coming into focus through a progressive blur.
